name: ImpactLine
tagline: The public delivery record: follow an enacted law to its Federal Register trail and its spending, with the gaps left visible.
indexable_why: false = staged: noindex on every page, robots.txt disallows everything, no sitemap, no IndexNow. The repository variable SITE_INDEXABLE=true makes the site indexable; the pages listed under duplicates_of_original stay noindex even then.
duplicates_why: The original is one page: the list of enacted laws, a view of the law you pick, and how evidence works. The home page, the law lists, and the method and about pages here repeat that, so they stay noindex and out of the sitemap, and each links to the original. The original has no page per law, no spending or Federal Register lists, no program pages and no downloads, so those are indexed once the site is live. This site adds to the original and never replaces it.
